prompt: Make a stunning, highly detailed interactive 3D web scene, entirely from scratch in code: a rooftop glass swimming pool at sunset. A swimming pool with thick clear glass walls sits on the roof of a skyscraper, high above a city skyline. Floating in the pool are a detailed toy pirate ship, an inflatable pink flamingo, a glossy rubber duck, a beach ball and a swim ring. Over 30 seconds the sunset fades into a warm night.

post.originalText:
Claude Opus 5.5 vs Claude Opus 5 (both on High)

Same prompt. An interactive 3D rooftop glass pool, built from scratch in code. 

- Opus 5.5: 68 min, ~$14
- Opus 5: 128 min, ~$68

Look at the buildings in the background too.
Opus 5.5 was 2x faster, 5x cheaper... and way more detailed... 

Just shows how much Anthropic cooked with Opus 5.5
